definition: any standard and official circulating medium of exchange, including coins, paper currency; money.
example_en: He had plenty of money with him.

definition: to plant, fix a stone, demarcating the boundary.
example_en: The surveyor fixed a stone at the boundary of the field.

definition: a kind of herb.
example_en: The darimushti herb grew on the slope of the hill.

definition: a watchman at a cemetery or crematory.
example_en: The cemetery watchman guarded the crematory all night.

definition: or, relating to, caused by wind.
example_en: The trees swayed due to the force caused by the wind.

definition: to make ready; to prepare.
example_en: The soldiers prepared everything for the war.

definition: a large quantity or number; a mass.
example_en: A large mass of people had gathered near the temple.

definition: the distance between the centre of a shaft and the centre of its eccentric wheel; eccentricity.
example: ಎಂಜಿನಿಯರ್ ಆ ಚಕ್ರದ ಉತ್ಕೇಂದ್ರೀಯ ದೂರವನ್ನು ಅಳೆದನು.
example_en: The engineer measured the eccentricity of that wheel.

definition: the act, process or an instance of urging, spurring (another) to action; incitement; instigation.
example_en: The teacher's incitement inspired the students.

definition: a game of chance usu. played with high stakes; gambling.
example_en: He lost a great deal of money in gambling.

definition: a deceitful or quarrelsome woman.
example_en: That quarrelsome woman used to fight with everyone.

definition: the act or an instance of paying money or submitting an article, etc.
example_en: He made the payment of the loan on time.

definition: the coverpage of a book, magazine, etc.; the cover-page.
example_en: The cover page of this book is very attractive.

definition: the cardinal number forty; 40.
example_en: There are forty students in the class.

definition: a king who is hostile.
example_en: The hostile king stationed his army at the border.

definition: a very renowned woman.
example: ಆಕೆ ಇಡೀ ರಾಜ್ಯದಲ್ಲಿ ಕೀರ್ತಿವಿಖ್ಯಾತೆ ಎಂದು ಹೆಸರಾಗಿದ್ದಳು.
example_en: She was renowned as a very famous woman throughout the kingdom.

definition: the condition of being struck with wonder, surprise, admiration, etc.
example: ಆ ಸುದ್ದಿ ಕೇಳಿ ಎಲ್ಲರಿಗೂ ಡಂಗು ಆಯಿತು.
example_en: Hearing that news, everyone was struck with wonder.

definition: the act or an instance of agitating; agitation; a spoiling of the state of being calm, lucid, etc.
example: ಆ ಘಟನೆ ಊರಿನಲ್ಲಿ ದೊಡ್ಡ ಉದ್ವೇಜನ ಉಂಟುಮಾಡಿತು.
example_en: That incident caused great agitation in the town.

definition: the act of giving up; abandonment.
example_en: He gave up his bad habits.

definition: the state of being fully grown or developed.
example_en: The fruit, having attained ripeness, had become sweet.

definition: the act of patrolling by the village police-men or guards.
example: ರಾತ್ರಿಯ ವೇಳೆ ತಳವಱಗಾಹು ಇಡೀ ಗ್ರಾಮದಲ್ಲಿ ನಡೆಯುತ್ತಿತ್ತು.
example_en: At night, the village police patrolling went on throughout the village.

definition: a sparrow of smaller size.
example_en: A small sparrow was perched near the window.

definition: to act hastily or impetuously.
example_en: Do not act hastily; think first and then decide.

definition: proper; suitable; fit.
example_en: This is not a suitable answer for this occasion.

definition: a fatigued eye.
example_en: Having studied all night, he got a fatigued eye.

definition: to utter as told; to repeat another's words.
example_en: He repeated the teacher's words as told.

definition: to come together; to meet; to encounter.
example_en: The two roads meet near the market.

definition: to donate for charitable purpose.
example_en: He donated money for the poor.

definition: not covered, concealed; not overlapped.
example: ಅನಚ್ಛಾದಿತ ಮಣ್ಣಿನ ಮೇಲೆ ಮಳೆ ನೀರು ಬೇಗ ಇಂಗಿತು.
example_en: The rain water quickly seeped into the uncovered soil.

definition: to become less strong; to lose strength.
example_en: His body lost its strength due to the illness.

definition: to cause to be seen; to allow to appear; to make visible; to show.
example_en: She lit the lamp and made the room visible to him.

definition: to perturb; to stir; to agitte.
example_en: The wind stirred the water and made it muddy.

definition: the act or process of making (something) light or lighter.
example_en: The new policy resulted in a lightening of the tax.

definition: the tree Symplocos laurina of Symplocaceae family.
example: ಕಾಡಿನ ಮಧ್ಯದಲ್ಲಿ ರೋಧ್ರ ಮರವು ದೊಡ್ಡದಾಗಿ ಬೆಳೆದಿದೆ.
example_en: The Symplocos laurina tree has grown large in the middle of the forest.

definition: the Ocean, the abode of Varuṇa.
example_en: The waves of the ocean, the abode of Varuna, dashed against the shore.

definition: pure, uncontaminated, and native Kannaḍa language.
example_en: They like to speak in pure Kannada.

definition: an accumulation and hiding or keeping in reserve of money or resources.
example_en: Because of his accumulation and safekeeping of money, the family survived hardship.

definition: to speak angrily.
example_en: She spoke angrily at her husband in anger.

definition: a moral principle.
example_en: Honesty must become a moral principle in everyone's life.

definition: the act of making a sound or sounds.
example_en: The sounding of the bell was heard throughout the temple.

definition: a mistake or oversight in speaking; a slip.
example: ಮಾತನಾಡುವಾಗ ಆಯಿತು ಬಾಯ್ಮೋಸ ಎಂದು ಅವನು ಕ್ಷಮೆ ಕೇಳಿದನು.
example_en: He apologized, saying that a slip of the tongue had occurred while speaking.

definition: to rub or pass over gently with the palm with affection or to alleviate pain, distress, etc.
example_en: She gently rubbed the aching hand.

definition: an indeclinable used to express one's dissent, restriction against something, decision against requirement order (not to do), etc.; 'no!'; 'don't do!'.
example: ಅಲ್ಲಿಗೆ ಹೋಗಬೇಡ, ಮಾ ಎಂದು ಅಪ್ಪ ಹೇಳಿದರು.
example_en: Father said, 'Don't go there, no!'

definition: (pl.) the five liquids - ghee (clarified butter), milk, honey, (edible) oil and spirituous liquor.
example_en: They offered the five liquids as part of the ritual worship.

definition: to have a longing for; to desire.
example: ಅವಳು ತನ್ನ ಊರಿಗೆ ಹೋಗಲು ಬಹಳ ಪಾರಯ್ಸಿದಳು.
example_en: She longed greatly to go to her hometown.

definition: a follower of Vaiṣṇava cult, propounded by Śr ī Rāmānuja.
example: ಆ ವೀರವೈಷ್ಣವನು ಪ್ರತಿದಿನ ರಾಮಾನುಜರ ಸ್ತೋತ್ರವನ್ನು ಪಠಿಸುತ್ತಾನೆ.
example_en: That follower of the Vaishnava cult recites Ramanuja's hymns every day.

definition: to greatly rejoice; to be delighted.
example_en: At the news of the victory, the whole town greatly rejoiced.

definition: a man who invades (another's country) with a military force to take away wealth; an invader.
example_en: The invader came from a distant land.

definition: a heavy soft malleable ductile plastic but inelastic bluish white metallic element found mostly in combination and used especially in pipes, cable sheaths, batteries, solder, and shields against radioactivity (symbol Pb.); lead.
example_en: Old pipes were made from lead.

definition: having no tail (as a frog or toad); anurous.
example_en: A tailless frog was swimming in the water.

definition: the decision of the juries or a report written in the presence of juries.
example_en: A report was written in the presence of juries about the dispute.

definition: an obstacle; an impediment.
example_en: An obstacle arose in the middle of the plan.

definition: extending over a large area; widely.
example_en: The fire spread widely across the forest.

definition: (fire) to be quenched.
example_en: As soon as the rain came, the fire in the hearth was quenched.

definition: (a woman) to discharge menses.
example_en: She began her menstrual period this month.

definition: (hist.) a particular unit of measure.
example: ಹಳೆಯ ದಾಖಲೆಗಳಲ್ಲಿ ಭೂಮಿಯನ್ನು ಹಾನಿ ಎಂಬ ಅಳತೆಯಲ್ಲಿ ಬರೆಯುತ್ತಿದ್ದರು.
example_en: In old records, they used to write land measurements in units called hani.

definition: (the bow-string) having been stretched; well strung.
example_en: The archer stood holding the well-strung bow.

definition: to bore a whole in.
example_en: The carpenter bored a hole in the plank.

definition: an enlargement of the thyroid gland, often visible as a swelling in the lower part of the front of the neck; goitre.
example_en: Goitre is caused due to iodine deficiency.

definition: a building furnished with facilities for travellers to stay in on their way.
example_en: The wayfarers rested at the travellers' inn.

definition: too far; at too distant or towards too far off a place.
example_en: The bird flew too far off and disappeared from sight.

definition: to have or become green.
example_en: After the rain came, the field turned green.

definition: the whirling sensation in the head; dizziness; giddiness.
example_en: She felt dizziness while travelling in the bus.

definition: to consecrate a person to a religious sacrifice.
example_en: The guru consecrated that disciple for the sacrifice.

definition: (the skin) to become thick and hardened; to become callous.
example_en: From all the walking, her heel had become calloused.

definition: unwavering, resolute mind.
example_en: The student of unwavering mind did not falter in any difficulty.

definition: a perverted, wicked, malicious man.
example_en: That wicked man wishes harm to everyone.

definition: the plant Dolichos lablab ( = Lablab niger) of Papilionaceae family.
example_en: Mother brought lablab beans for cooking.

definition: one who has come in or arrived at.
example_en: The officials examined that new arrival at the port.

definition: (pl.) figures written one below another, as in a column.
example_en: In the account book the figures were written neatly, one below another.

definition: the act of concealing deliberately (something) from another's or otheṛs knowledge.
example_en: He deliberately concealed that truth from others.

definition: the quality or condition of being rare; as a) uncommonness; scarcity; b) excellence; rarity.
example_en: Everyone knew the rarity of this manuscript.

definition: to let (a liquid) fall in drops; to drop.
example_en: He slowly let the oil drop from the bottle.

definition: a man who sets fire to; one who destroys (something) by fire.
example: ಕಿಚ್ಚುಗಾರ ಕಾಡಿಗೆ ಬೆಂಕಿ ಇಟ್ಟು ಎಲ್ಲವನ್ನೂ ಸುಟ್ಟನು.
example_en: The fire-setter set fire to the forest and burned everything down.

definition: abundance; plenty; plentitude.
example_en: That year, there was abundance in the harvest.

definition: a rod on which a wheel turns; an axle.
example_en: The cart's axle broke and the wheel came off.

definition: (dial.) a thing that blocks the passage of a liquid; a stopper; a plug.
example_en: The stopper sat tightly in the mouth of the bottle.

definition: satirical speech intended to inflict derision, ridicule in a poignant manner.
example_en: His satirical speech hurt everyone.

definition: the underground portion of an ant-hill.
example_en: During the rainy season, the ants gathered inside the underground part of the ant-hill.

definition: any of the weapons with a pointed blade and a hilt, to thrust or pierce into.
example_en: He stabbed the enemy with the thrusting weapon.

definition: a giving or taking of one thing for another; an exchange.
example_en: Both benefited from the exchange of goods.

definition: a continuous pain in the head; headache.
example_en: She took medicine to reduce her headache.

definition: an uninhabited, not maintained, dilapidated house.
example_en: A dilapidated, uninhabited house stands at the edge of the town.

definition: something that has become old, stale or spoiled.
example_en: Mother threw away the stale rice.

definition: from; through.
example: ಅವನ ಕೈಯಲ್ಲಿ ಈ ಸಂದೇಶ ನನಗೆ ಬಂತು.
example_en: This message came to me through him.

definition: that which is barren, sterile.
example: ಆ ಭೂಮಿ ಬಱಡು ಆಗಿ ಬೆಳೆ ಬೆಳೆಯಲಿಲ್ಲ.
example_en: That land was barren and no crop grew.

definition: not diffusing oneself through out; not pervading; not spreading.
example: ಈ ಬಣ್ಣ ಇಡೀ ಬಟ್ಟೆಯಲ್ಲಿ ಅವ್ಯಾಪಕವಾಗಿ ಕಂಡಿತು.
example_en: This colour appeared non-pervading across the whole cloth.

definition: that which is new, young or fresh.
example_en: She was wearing new, fresh clothes.

definition: the inner sole of a footwear.
example_en: The inner sole of the footwear had worn out.

definition: a bruise, bruised area, as caused by whipping or a heavy blow; a weal.
example: ಚಾಟಿಯ ಪೆಟ್ಟಿನಿಂದ ಅವನ ಬೆನ್ನಿನ ಮೇಲೆ ಗಾದಿ ಮೂಡಿತು.
example_en: From the lash of the whip, a bruise appeared on his back.

definition: a mean or worthless object.
example: ಅವನು ಆ ಹಳೆಯ ವಸ್ತುವನ್ನು ಅಣಕ ಎಂದು ಬಿಸಾಡಿದನು.
example_en: He threw away that old object as a worthless thing.

definition: a weak decoction of barley; barley-gruel.
example_en: They gave the patient barley-gruel to drink in the morning.

definition: a joyous or merry-making dancing.
example_en: The joyous dancing at the festival delighted everyone.

definition: to drop (a liquid) drop by drop.
example_en: The nurse dropped the medicine drop by drop into the child's mouth.

definition: a man who commits or is habitually inclined to, adultery.
example: ಊರಿನ ಜನ ಆ ಚಾಪಟಿಯನನ್ನು ದೂರ ಇಟ್ಟರು.
example_en: The villagers kept away from that adulterer.

definition: a pearl inlaid into a bracelet.
example_en: The pearl inlaid in the queen's bracelet shone in the light.

definition: the thing at which one is employed; an occupation; a profession; an employment.
example_en: He is searching for a new occupation.

definition: a kind of medicinal substance.
example_en: The doctor gave naga-bhasma to the patient.

definition: the tree Ficus gibbosa ( = Urostigma volubile) of Moraceae family; stone fig tree.
example_en: There was a stone fig tree near the village.

definition: swiftness; quickness.
example_en: Everyone was astonished seeing his swiftness.

definition: the yard surrounding, surrounded by a house; a house-yard.
example_en: There are flowering plants in that house-yard.

definition: damaging, tending to damage.
example_en: Excessive sunlight is damaging to the crops.

definition: a decorative picture produced on a cloth, wall, article, etc.
example_en: There was a beautiful decorative picture on the wall.

definition: lack of trustworthiness; unreliability.
example_en: Her unreliability caused us trouble.

definition: finely ground meal of grain as wheat, rice, etc.; flour.
example_en: Mother kneaded wheat flour with water.

definition: illness; disease.
example_en: He was exhausted from illness.

definition: a merchant who sells his goods carrying them from place to place; a peddler; a hawker.
example_en: The peddler sells goods in the villages.

definition: a room in the loft of a house.
example_en: There were old belongings in the loft room of that house.

definition: a fence put up or a hedge raised around (a building, piece of land, etc.).
example_en: We have built a fence around the house.

definition: the legal statement oral or written, of a person's wishes concerning the disposal of his or her property after death; a will.
example: ಅಜ್ಜ ಸಾಯುವ ಮುನ್ನ ತನ್ನ ಆಸ್ತಿಗೆ ಸಂಬಂಧಿಸಿದ ವಿಲ್ಲು ಬರೆದಿಟ್ಟನು.
example_en: Before dying, grandfather wrote a will concerning his property.

definition: worthy of imitating or following; exemplary.
example_en: His discipline is worthy of imitation by everyone.

definition: the tender or cozy sunlight (as in the morning).
example_en: The tender morning sunlight gives pleasure to the body.

definition: an arresting or being arrested; a taking or being taken into custody.
example_en: The thief's capture was done by the villagers themselves.

definition: (mus.) a measuring of regularity in rhythm.
example_en: The teacher taught the disciple the rhythm measure.

definition: a very high degree of temperature; superheat.
example_en: The travellers were distressed by the desert's superheat.

definition: a naturally raised part of the earth's surface, usu. rising more or less abruptly, and larger than a hill; a mountain.
example_en: The Himalayan mountain is the highest in the world.

definition: an eye with a diseased flesh grown within.
example: ಆ ಮುದುಕನಿಗೆ ಮಾಂಸಗಣ್ಣು ಬಂದು ಕಣ್ಣಿನ ಶಸ್ತ್ರಚಿಕಿತ್ಸೆ ಮಾಡಿಸಿಕೊಂಡನು.
example_en: That old man developed a fleshy growth in his eye (māmsagaṇṇu) and had eye surgery done.

definition: a kind of stuffed pudding.
example: ಅಮ್ಮ ಹಬ್ಬಕ್ಕೆ ಹೊಟ್ಟೆಕಡುಬು ಮಾಡಿ ಎಲ್ಲರಿಗೂ ಹಂಚಿದಳು.
example_en: Mother made stuffed pudding for the festival and distributed it to everyone.

definition: a man who has been given a land, village, etc. as a tax-free gift and holding feudal rights.
example_en: That jagirdar was the master of the entire village.

definition: a pot belly.
example_en: People were laughing seeing his pot belly.

definition: to break in upon; interrupt thoughtlessly; to transgress the order or successiveness; to disturb; to violate.
example: ಮಾತನಾಡುತ್ತಿದ್ದವರ ಮಧ್ಯೆ ಅನುಗೂಡಿಸಿ ಅವನು ಪ್ರಶ್ನೆ ಕೇಳಿದನು.
example_en: He interrupted the conversation and asked a question.

definition: the state of being surprised; feeling aroused by something unusual, unexpected, strange or incredible; wonder or astonishment; a surprise.
example_en: The people felt astonishment on hearing the new matter.

definition: to be seen; to appear.
example_en: The hill appeared in the distance.

definition: the act of pulling, drawing, hauling towards.
example: ಅವನು ಹಗ್ಗದ ಸೆಳೆಯಿಂದ ದೋಣಿಯನ್ನು ದಡಕ್ಕೆ ತಂದನು.
example_en: He brought the boat to the shore by pulling the rope.

definition: not made free from other matter or from impurities; not purified.
example_en: This oil is still in an unrefined state.

definition: to engage in a discussion or argument; to discuss; to debate.
example_en: The two ministers discussed and debated about the agreement.

definition: a man who propells a boat; a boatman.
example: ಪಾತಿಗ ದೋಣಿಯನ್ನು ನದಿಯ ಆಚೆ ದಡಕ್ಕೆ ನಡೆಸಿದನು.
example_en: The boatman steered the boat to the far bank of the river.

definition: a place where bread, biscuits etc. are baked and sold; a bakery.
example_en: I brought fresh bread from the bakery.

definition: a necklace of white pearls.
example_en: At the wedding the bride wore a necklace of white pearls.

definition: a virtuous, meritorious man.
example_en: A virtuous man does no harm to anyone.

definition: to give; to offer (something to someone); to present; to submit.
example_en: The disciples offered fruit to their teacher.

definition: the condition of being tied, fastened firmly or associated perfectly.
example_en: They made sure the tightness of the rope's knot did not loosen.

definition: (coll.) trash - a) parts that have been broken off, stripped off, etc., esp. leaves, twigs, husks, and other plant trimmings; b) broken, discarded or worthless things; rubbish; refuse.
example_en: She swept away the trash from the courtyard and cleaned it.

definition: an expression of opposition, disapproval or dislike; an objection.
example: ಅವನು ಆ ನಿರ್ಧಾರದ ಬಗ್ಗೆ ಯತಾರಾಜಿ ವ್ಯಕ್ತಪಡಿಸಿದನು.
example_en: He expressed his objection to that decision.

definition: an intense desire.
example: ಅವನಿಗೆ ಆ ಹುದ್ದೆಯ ಮೇಲೆ ಆಯಲ್ಲಕ ಇತ್ತು.
example_en: He had an intense desire for that post.

definition: an apparent ring of light encircling the sun, moon or other luminous body, caused by refraction of light through ice crystals in our atmosphere; a halo.
example: ಇಂದು ರಾತ್ರಿ ಚಂದ್ರನ ಸುತ್ತ ಸುಂದರವಾದ ಗುಡಿ ಕಂಡಿತು.
example_en: Tonight, a beautiful halo appeared around the moon.

definition: causing to give forth light or shine brightly.
example_en: The bright shining light illuminated the house.

definition: that is long; lengthy.
example_en: That story grew into a lengthy essay.

definition: a young one of an animal.
example_en: That dog's puppy is very cute.

definition: a measure of time equal to forty eight seconds.
example: ಹಳೆಯ ಲೆಕ್ಕದಲ್ಲಿ ಒಂದು ಚಣ ಎಂಬ ಕಾಲಮಾನ ಇತ್ತು.
example_en: In the old reckoning there was a time unit called chana.

definition: a strong, metal or wooden box.
example_en: She carefully kept the jewellery in the strong box.

definition: the quality, condition or fact of shining by reflected light; gloss; sheen; lustre.
example_en: That ornament had a beautiful lustre.

definition: an administrative division of a district.
example_en: Work is going on in our taluk office.

definition: the act of spitting the saliva.
example_en: His spit fell on the road.

definition: conjunction; union.
example: ಎರಡು ನದಿಗಳ ಸಮಾಯೋಗ ಆ ಸ್ಥಳದಲ್ಲಿ ಆಗುತ್ತದೆ.
example_en: The union of the two rivers happens at that place.

definition: the quality of being persoal, individual or subjective.
example_en: The quality of being subjective stands out in this writing.

definition: a cutting cross-wise.
example_en: The surgeon made a cross-wise cut and examined the tumour.

definition: any of the growths covering the body of a bird or making up a large part of the wing surface, as down or contour feathers; a feather.
example_en: The peacock's feather is very beautiful.

definition: the plant Cassia auriculata of Caesalpiniaceae family; tanner's cassia.
example_en: The tanner's cassia plant has medicinal properties.

definition: a menial, servile work.
example_en: He had to do menial work.

definition: the evergreen tree Cinnamomum zeylanicum of Lauraceae family.
example_en: She added a little cinnamon powder to the cooking.

definition: the tongue (of a person) that stammers.
example_en: That boy's stammering tongue improved with treatment.

definition: the course of a stream, river, etc.
example_en: The boat moved slowly along the course of the stream.

definition: to converge - a) to come together or tend to come together at a point; b) to move toward each other or toward the same place, purpose or result; c) (math.) to approach a definite limit, as the sum of certain infinite series of numbers (Ex: 1/2+1/4+1/8+1/16+1/32. = 2).
example: ಎಲ್ಲಾ ಜನರ ಅಭಿಪ್ರಾಯಗಳು ಒಂದೇ ತೀರ್ಮಾನಕ್ಕೆ ಅಭಿಸರಿಸಿದವು.
example_en: All the people's opinions converged to a single conclusion.

definition: not impeded; not obstructed; unrestrained; unhampered; unaffected; absolute.
example_en: His freedom remained unrestrained and unaffected.

definition: to use, wield a weapon; to hit, injure or kill another with a weapon.
example_en: The hunter wielded a weapon and went into the forest.

definition: to move quickly; hurry; run; to trot.
example: ರೈತನ ಮಗ ಬಸ್ಸು ಹಿಡಿಯಲು ರಸ್ತೆಯಲ್ಲಿ ಕುದುಕಿದನು.
example_en: The farmer's son hurried along the road to catch the bus.

definition: the act or an instance of uttering a piercing cry in pain; a screaming.
example_en: He let out a piercing scream from the pain.

definition: the biological need for water, characterised by a sensation of dryness in the mouth and throat.
example_en: After the long walk, he felt thirsty.

definition: the hottest season of the year; summer.
example_en: In the hot season people seek out shade.

definition: the tree Ficus virens ( = F. infectoria) of Moraceae family.
example_en: There is a shringi tree in the temple courtyard.

definition: in the game of chance, a score of two on one die and four on the other, when rolled.
example_en: When the dice were rolled, duchchauka came up.

definition: a small quantity of water that can be gulped at one time.
example: ದಾರಿಯಲ್ಲಿ ಬಾಯಾರಿದಾಗ ಅವನು ಒಂದು ಗುಟುಕುನೀರು ಕುಡಿದನು.
example_en: When he was thirsty on the way, he drank a small gulp of water.

definition: (dial.) a very small island; an islet.
example: ಆ ನದಿಯ ನಡುವೆ ಒಂದು ಚಿಕ್ಕ ತುರುತ್ತಿ ಇದೆ.
example_en: There is a small islet in the middle of that river.

definition: to appear; to come to be seen.
example_en: As the cloud moved away, the moon came to be seen.

definition: a word or a combination of words by which a person, place or thing, a body or class or any object of thought is designated, called or known; a name.
example: ಈ ಊರಿನ ಪೆಸರು ಹಳೆಯ ಶಾಸನಗಳಲ್ಲಿ ದೊರೆಯುತ್ತದೆ.
example_en: This town's name is found in ancient inscriptions.

definition: a feeling or condition of hostility; hatred; ill will; animosity; antagonism; hatred.
example: ಇಬ್ಬರ ನಡುವೆ ಹಳೆಯ ಬೇರ ಇನ್ನೂ ಇದೆ.
example_en: The old hatred between the two still exists.

definition: the surface of the earth.
example_en: The surface of the earth is covered with mountains.

definition: to agitate the mind; to stir or disturb the feelings.
example_en: That news agitated her mind.

definition: the rendering of something into another language or into one's own from another language; translation.
example_en: The translation of this agreement is not yet complete.

definition: not well done; wrongly done.
example: ಆ ಕೆಲಸ ಅಪಕೃತವಾಗಿದ್ದ ಕಾರಣ ಮತ್ತೆ ಮಾಡಬೇಕಾಯಿತು.
example_en: Because that work was wrongly done, it had to be redone.

definition: to come or go out.
example_en: The children came out of the house to play.

definition: a man whose profession is cooking food; a cook.
example_en: The household cook makes delicious food.

definition: the form of an alphabetical letter in the English language used to begin a sentence or proper name; a capital letter.
example_en: An English sentence must always begin with a capital letter.

definition: he who diffuses, spreads or scatters (something).
example_en: A spreader spread rumors everywhere.

definition: to draw back (as from a blow, difficulty, etc.); to flinch.
example_en: When he saw the snake, he flinched back.

definition: the part of the body connecting the head to the shoulders; the neck.
example_en: A garland was put on her neck.

definition: a man deprived of or not having something.
example_en: He suffered, deprived of wealth.

definition: any of the foods that is crisp and eaten slowly and steadily in small quantities, with a crunching sound.
example_en: The child likes eating crisp snacks very much.

definition: a kind of herbal plant.
example: ಕಬ್ಬತ್ತಿ ಗಿಡವನ್ನು ಹಳ್ಳಿಯ ಜನ ಔಷಧಿಗಾಗಿ ಬೆಳೆಸುತ್ತಾರೆ.
example_en: Villagers grow the kabbatti plant for medicine.

definition: (astrol.) a man born under the zodiac sign Taurus, the second of the twelve signs.
example_en: A Taurus-born person has the qualities of the Taurus sign.

definition: a blaming or accusing; accusation.
example_en: An accusation came for a fault he did not commit.

definition: (pl.) seventy persons.
example_en: Seventy persons lived in that town.

definition: the plant Vaccinium neilgherrense of Vacciniaceae family.
example_en: The olleynangu plant grows at the foot of the hill.

definition: the part around the anus of a horse.
example_en: The area around the horse's anus was wounded.

definition: (pl.) five hoods (as of mythological serpent).
example_en: That temple's idol has a serpent-canopy of five hoods.

definition: an excellent brāhmaṇa.
example_en: The excellent brahmana had the initiation ceremony performed for his students.

definition: a bracelet worn on the upper arm; an armlet.
example_en: The princess had worn a golden armlet.

definition: application of eye-wash.
example_en: They applied the eye-wash to the child's eyes.

definition: a demand or request made forcefully or authoritatively.

definition: a thick rope, cable made of intertwisted strands of fibre, thin wires, etc.
example_en: They tied the plant to the pole with a rope.

definition: the place, region that behind some object.
example_en: There was an old temple in the background behind that hill.

definition: to take out.
example_en: She took the fruits out of the basket.

definition: the act or an instance of dropping down or causing to fall down.
example_en: The falling down of the rock happened suddenly.

definition: a written command or instruction.
example_en: The king sent a written command to the army.

definition: a play with pebbles.
example_en: The children were playing a pebble game in the yard.

definition: a moving up and down, back to forth or from side to side in quick succession.
example_en: The quivering of the leaves indicated the presence of wind.

definition: to cause to run.
example_en: The driver made the bus run.

definition: a spider, as an enemy of mosquitoes.
example_en: The mosquito-eating spider catches and eats mosquitoes.

example_en: There was immense physical strength in the wrestler's body.

definition: a tall strong or masculine and aggressive woman; Amazon.
example_en: A woman like an Amazon faced the opponent with courage.

definition: a horseman well-known for his valour.
example: ಉಗ್ಗಡರಾವುತ ತನ್ನ ಶೌರ್ಯದಿಂದ ಯುದ್ಧದಲ್ಲಿ ಹೆಸರು ಗಳಿಸಿದನು.
example_en: The valorous horseman earned fame in battle through his bravery.

definition: to cause to appear.
example_en: He showed his painting to the teacher.

definition: to reduce to ruin; to ruin.
example_en: Gambling ruined him.

definition: at, to or toward the rear; backward.
example_en: He turned and looked backward.

definition: a man whose work is building with stone, brick, concrete, etc. ; a mason.
example_en: The mason is building a wall with concrete.

definition: the space or period of time in between; an interval.

definition: to make suitable; to fit in; to change so as to fit, conform, make suitable, etc.; to adjust; to adapt.

example_en: The cows were grazing grass in the meadow.

definition: a sticky, colloidal carbohydrate exuded by trees as acacia; gum.

example_en: The child pressed its lips and made a smacking sound.

definition: an elephant in rut.
example_en: The elephant in rut came walking slowly through the forest.

definition: a work done or duty performed for another or others; service.
example_en: The servant performed his service to the master with devotion.

definition: a young of a cobra.

definition: a cradle hung from above.

definition: cool breeze.
example_en: A cool breeze was blowing on the hilltop.

definition: the number seven and a half; 7.5.
example: ಜ್ಯೋತಿಷಿ ಅವನ ಸಾಡೇಸಾತ ಕಾಲ ಬಂದಿದೆ ಎಂದನು.

definition: to collect, recover tax.

definition: the plant Eugenia codyensis of Myrtaceae family with evergreen leaves.
example_en: The kadu jambu neerale tree looked green and lush even in summer.

definition: an agricultural implement used for cutting, lifting, turning over, and partly pulverising soil; a plough.
example: ಆ ರೈತ ಎತ್ತುಗಳ ಸಹಾಯದಿಂದ ನೇಗಲ್ ಹೂಡಿ ಉಳುಮೆ ಮಾಡಿದನು.

definition: to go under the surface of a liquid; to plunge or sink oneself in to water etc.
example: ಮಕ್ಕಳು ಕೊಳದ ನೀರಿನಲ್ಲಿ ಆಳಿ ಮುಳುಗಿ ಆಡಿದರು.

example_en: The old machine is now defunct and does not work.

definition: of or related to the native provincial deputy or governor of the old Mogul empire.

definition: love; affection; fondness.
example: ಆ ಇಬ್ಬರ ನಡುವಿನ ಮಚ್ಚುಗೆ ಎಲ್ಲರಿಗೂ ಗೊತ್ತಿತ್ತು.

definition: either of the two feathered forelimbs of a bird, either or not fully developed for flying, for flight, balance in running, for swimming, etc.; a wing.

definition: to have name; to be known by one's name.

definition: capable of making all things visible or obvious.

definition: having perfect knowledge.

definition: a military force; an army.

definition: to cause to do, work.

definition: the status of or state or fact of being, a member (of a society organisation, legislature, etc.); membership.

definition: a large container; a cauldron.

example_en: They have grown kapparavaḷḷi along the border of the garden.

definition: to move slightly.

definition: to put forth feathers; (the wing of a bird) to become strong.

definition: an unworthy life, as of a contemptible creature; any creature belonging to inferior class.

definition: to take or use a spear, lance.

definition: a skilled, proficient woman; an expert woman.

definition: (math.) to separate into equal parts by the proces of division; to divide.

definition: a short poem with a witty or satirical point; an epigram.

definition: a child (girl or son).

example_en: That is a thing inferior in comparison to this saree.

definition: easiness; absence of fatigue; effortlessness.
example: ದೀರ್ಘ ಅಭ್ಯಾಸದಿಂದ ಆ ಕೆಲಸ ಅವನಿಗೆ ಅಶ್ರಮವಾಯಿತು.
example_en: Through long practice, that work became effortless for him.

definition: to be immersed, plunged in (water).
example_en: The swimmer was immersed deep in the river.

definition: a well known hero.
example_en: That well-known hero's fame had spread everywhere.

definition: to cover incompletely.
example_en: She covered her face incompletely with the end of her sari.

definition: a man living in the neighbouring house; a neighbour.
example_en: The neighbour always helps in times of trouble.

definition: being done by oneself.
example_en: This is work done by himself.

definition: a mixing with another; a mingling.
example: ಎರಡು ಬಣ್ಣಗಳ ಉಳಿತದಿಂದ ಹೊಸ ಬಣ್ಣ ಬಂತು.
example_en: A new colour came from the mixing of two colours.

definition: to cause to be fixed as a target (to hit, shoot, at).
example_en: The teacher made the disciple fix his aim to shoot the arrow.

definition: (fig.) a statement contradicting one's own statement made earlier.
example_en: Hearing his self-contradicting statement, everyone became confused.

definition: the food served for eating or eaten.
example_en: They gave food to the poor free of charge.

definition: a person skilled in or practising magic or sorcery. a magician; a conjuror.
example_en: The magician amazed the people with his spells.

definition: to appear; to occur or be present.
example_en: Suddenly a black cloud appeared in the sky.

definition: a kind of wall built out into the water to restrain currents, protect a harbour; a jetty.
example_en: The boats stop near the jetty.

definition: the fibres of a fruit.
example_en: They removed the fibres of the fruit and sowed the seed.
